author: Ari Koslow
title: Cal Raleigh (oblique) confirms he will be activated Tuesday
desc: Cal Raleigh told reporters he will be activated from the injured list on Tuesday.
impact: Raleigh will be back after concluding his rehab assignment over the weekend. He'll return from a month-long absence.

author: David Leisering
title: Eiberson Castellano optioned to Triple-A Albuquerque
desc: Eiberson Castellano has been optioned to Triple-A Albuquerque by the Colorado Rockies. The move was made as Victor Vodnik (elbow) was reinstated from the injured list.
impact: Castellano made his only appearance - and his major league debut - on Sunday in the Rockies' 23-9 win over the Athletics. He recorded a three-inning save, allowing no runs on four hits while striking out two. Castellano was having a solid season in the minors, posting a 2.44 ERA in 59 innings between Double-A Portland and Triple-A Albuquerque. It's likely Castellano will return to Colorado at some point later in the year.

author: David Leisering
title: Victor Vodnik (elbow) reinstated from injured list
desc: Victor Vodnik (elbow) has been reinstated from the 15-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies. In a corresponding move, Eiberson Castellano was optioned to Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Vodnik missed nearly a month of action, last appearing in a game on May 18 against the Rangers. The righthander struggled prior to his stint on the IL, going 1-2 with an 8.00 ERA, a 2.11 WHIP, and a 16:13 K:BB ratio in 18 innings. He pitched two scoreless innings during his rehab stint at Triple-A Albuquerque, walking one and striking out four. He'll have an opportunity to compete for saves again with the Rockies.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Jenkins (shoulder) to join Single-A Cedar Rapids for rehab
desc: Walker Jenkins is continuing his rehab assignment with Single-A Cedar Rapids.
impact: Jenkins will continue on the next phase of his rehab. He continues to work his way back from a shoulder injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brady Basso optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics optioned Brady Basso to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Basso will return to Triple-A after he was called up over the weekend. Luis Morales was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Morales recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Athletics recalled Luis Morales from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Morales gets recalled as a fresh arm. Brady Basso was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronny Mauricio (thumb) could begin rehab assignment this week
desc: Ronny Mauricio could begin a rehab assignment later this week.
impact: Mauricio was cleared to resume baseball activities last week. If he can begin a rehab assignment this week, he could be activated by the end of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ron Marinaccio suspended three games
desc: The MLB has suspended Ron Marinaccio three games.
impact: Marinaccio will be suspended after he hit Gunnar Henderson on Saturday. He will appeal the suspension on Monday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Troy Melton scratched from start Monday
desc: Troy Melton was scratched from his scheduled start on Monday against the Astros due to back tightness.
impact: Melton will be further evaluated at which point an update should be provided on his status.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jose Fermin recalled by Angels
desc: Righthander Jose Fermin was called back up by the Los Angeles Angels on Monday.
impact: Fermin was with the Angels for all of May before being sent back down to Triple-A on June 2nd, but he is now back with the big-league club. In 15 innings at the MLB level this season, the 24-year-old has allowed nine runs and struck out 18 batters.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Drew Pomeranz designated for assignment
desc: Drew Pomeranz was designated for assignment by the Los Angeles Angels on Monday.
impact: Pomeranz will now hit the waivers after he was DFA'd in a series of moves by the Angels. In 23 1/3 innings out of the bullpen this season, the veteran lefty has a 5.01 ERA and 16 strikeouts.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Brett Kerry called up by Angels
desc: The Los Angeles Angels selected the contract of right-hander Brett Kerry on Monday.
impact: Kerry will join the big league club after being selected to fill the spot of Grayson Rodriguez, who was placed on the IL on Monday. In 62 1/3 innings at the Triple-A level this season, Kerry has a 5.92 ERA with 59 strikeouts.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Grayson Rodriguez (low back inflammation) placed on 15-day IL
desc: Grayson Rodriguez was placed on the 15-day injured list on Monday with low back inflammation.
impact: Rodriguez was pulled from his start on Sunday against the Rays in the third inning, and he will now spend at least the next two weeks on the shelf. However, the extent of the injury and timetable for return remain unknown. Righthander Brett Kerry was called up in a corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nolan McLean to start Wednesday for Mets
desc: Nolan McLean will make his next start for the Mets on Wednesday against the Reds.
impact: Kodai Senga will return from the injured list to start the day before on Tuesday for the Mets.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Conine (hamstring) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Griffin Conine is scheduled to begin a rehab assignment on Tuesday with Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Conine has been on the injured list since April. He'll have a chance to be activated by the end of June or early July.
